title: a decide line on a shaped plan carries writes_to and reads
intention: The rehearsal's decide — the amendment entrance to a ticket's decisions — gives each new or rewritten line writes_to and reads (cairn rehearse --decide ... --writes-to P --reads P, repeatable) and refuses a line without them on a ticket whose falsifier carries clauses, so amendment cannot become the prose leak the cast door closed.
why: Measured 2026-11-05: cairn/machines/rehearsal/rehearsal.py:969 writes a decide entry as {n, text, by, step, source, at}, with no paths; cairn/machines/rehearsal/__main__.py:62 takes --decide STEP LINE and --by only. The parent e4f02a1ceef5 makes the ticket plan JSON at the cast door (Akien 2026-11-05: 'should be json'); this reader must read the new shape before the door admits it.
traces_to: Law 4 and Law 1 via parent e4f02a1ceef5; RULE 1 (each reader's change lives in its own component).
how: decide() gains writes_to and reads keyword lists, written onto the entry; on a ticket whose falsifier is a dict carrying clauses, both must be given (empty list allowed only when passed explicitly) or decide refuses naming them; __main__ gains repeatable --writes-to and --reads plus --no-writes / --no-reads for an explicit empty; red-first proof over a scratch ticket.
falsifier: (1) on a scratch ticket with a clauses falsifier, decide without paths is refused and the ticket bytes are unchanged; (2) with --writes-to and --reads the line lands carrying both lists; (3) on a scratch ticket with a string falsifier, decide without paths lands as it does at HEAD.

decisions.text: Red-first proof cairn/machines/rehearsal/proofs/test_a_decide_line_on_a_shaped_plan_carries_its_paths.py, check()/FAILURES/main() shape, one tooth per falsifier clause, PROVES = {'70f91244f3c0': {'1': 'clause_1', '2': 'clause_2', '3': 'clause_3'}} (tooth names written at build, each named for its clause). Red at HEAD on the new-shape teeth.
